{{Top}}
{{Youmay|manually-operated turrets|[[Autoturret/Legends|Autoturret]]}}
[[File:ATTE-TCW.png|thumb|right|300px|The [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] and its many turret-mounted laser cannons]]
A '''turret''' was a mount for a weapon that allowed the operator to rotate and/or pitch the weapon to improve aim and to track moving targets. Turrets could be incorporated into fixed and mobile ground emplacements&mdash;such as the [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]] anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] battery&mdash;or as a starship [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery station]]&mdash;such as the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannons]].

The [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunship]] was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] fighter equipped with two double laser turrets. The [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] (AAT) had a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] mounted on a turret as its primary weapon, while a modified version of the AAT, the [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Defoliator Deployment Tank]], had a more powerful [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]] mounted on its primary turret. The [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] had a large turret-mounted heavy projectile [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]], with four additional ball-turret laser cannons on the front and a pair of laser cannon turrets facing the rear.
